Name: Stardew Lottery Letters
Author: Jokerine
Description:
[i][b][center][color=#66CDAA]Do not download this mod from any place other than NexusMods or the Chucklefish forums! [url=http://www.stardewvalleymods.net/]WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET[/url]STEALS MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DO NOT download any mods there! If you see my mods anywhere other than Nexus or the forums, please link me to the site asap. Thank you![/color][/center][/b][/i]
Hey, folks! This mod simply changes the text from the letters sent by Mom and Dad to lottery winning/losing notifications.

I'm weird and didn't like how these letters were said to come from your parents (something I've also always disliked in Animal Crossing), and since they give you money and assorted items, I figured, why not? So, sometimes you'll be lucky and get gold... and sometimes you'll get a consolation prize. I find it much more entertaining this way.

[i][size=1]Keep in mind this will not be compatible with other mods that edit [font=Courier New]mail.xnb,[/font] such as Bird [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/309/?]Replacments for Babies and Toddlers[/url], unless you unpack both files separately and merge the contents. You've been warned.[/size][/i]

To install, make a backup of your files and unzip the [font=Courier New]Content [/font]folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley[/font] folder, overwriting everything. If you're using Steam, the location should be[font=Courier New] "Steam\steamapps\Stardew Valley".

[/font]Enjoy!
